# Steering Committee Notes - Northstar Pilot
Author: Steering committee secretary. Date: 2026-09-25. Type: meeting notes.
1. The committee reviewed the revised engagement fee of $42,000 and did not dispute the amount.
2. The discussed payment structure was 50% upfront and 50% after acceptance; no vote was taken on the payment schedule.
3. The committee noted that client finance had not yet signed off on any revised commercial terms.
